$description: Talyxel Park — tokens shared by both themes, taken from the Parkmakers Figma design. W3C design-token format (DTCG); importable as Figma variables or with Tokens Studio. Run `npm run tokens` after changing.

radius-sm.$description: Inputs, poll options, small icon tiles, tool buttons, comment bubbles

radius.$description: Images inside cards, quick-link icon tiles, inner panels

radius-control.$description: Buttons, chips, tabs, search, progress bars

font-display.$description: Headings, titles and the brand name

gutter.$description: Space between the window edge and the content; pages line up with the top bar (16px on phones)
